Samuel Meesala is an Evangelist, Christian Author, and the Founder of Jesus Anoints Ministries- a global gospel ministry dedicated to proclaiming the Word of God, the Lordship of Jesus Christ, and the work of the Holy Spirit in these last days. He is known for his Bible-centered teaching, prophetic insight, and emphasis on spiritual maturity, holiness, and unity in the Body of Christ.

Samuel Meesala is the author of the books The Silence of God: A Season When He Hides His Face and Heaven Withholds Its Light and Restoring the Body of Christ: A Call to Unity, Truth, and Spiritual Maturity in the Last Days, published on Amazon and distributed internationally. His writings focus on deep spiritual formation, repentance, revival, and preparation for the return of Christ.

Through Jesus Anoints Ministries, he conducts preaching engagements, online broadcasts, teaching series, and prophetic messages, reaching believers worldwide via YouTube, Facebook, and digital platforms. His ministry is centered on exalting Jesus Christ, teaching sound doctrine, and calling the Church to live by the power of the Holy Spirit.

He is also a two-time kidney transplant recipient, whose personal testimony of healing and endurance through end-stage renal failure has strengthened his message of faith, perseverance, and total dependence on God.

Samuel Meesala is joyfully married to his wife, Tiffany Meesala, a fellow graduate in Religious Studies who shares his deep passion for the Word of God and Christian ministry. They are blessed with a son, Joshua Meesala, who is currently pursuing his studies in college toward becoming a physician assistant.

The Meesala family walks in the love of Jesus Christ and in the power of the Holy Spirit, serving the Lord in unity, humility, and devotion. Together, they seek to live as a household consecrated to God, ministering as the Lord directs-bearing witness to Christ, strengthening believers, and serving with compassion.

Evangelist Samuel Meesala carries the heart of a bondservant of Jesus Christ, desiring in all things to glorify God, to seek the highest good of others through divine love, and to serve the Church in Spirit and in truth.
If you would like to invite Evg. Rev. Samuel Meesala to minister at your church, event, or nation, we would be honored to connect with you. Please contact us!

blocks.text: And you will be a fruitful tree planted & fed by the streams of water (word of God)-Psalms 1:3

We believe that the Holy Scriptures teach that there is only one true and living God, eternal and unchanging, who has chosen to reveal Himself as Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. He is perfect in all His ways—Creator, Redeemer, and Sustainer of all things. Scripture References: Deuteronomy 6:4; Isaiah 43:10–11; Matthew 28:19; Luke 3:22.
2) A Personal Relationship With Jesus Christ:

We believe that every believer is called to have a personal, intimate, and abiding relationship with Jesus Christ, for apart from Him we can do nothing. He is our life, strength, and source of all spiritual fruitfulness. In His presence we find fellowship, guidance, and the assurance that He will never leave us nor forsake us. Scripture References: John 15:1–5; Hebrews 13:5–6.

We believe that every believer has a unique ministry and calling from God—a purpose that no one else can fulfill. As members of the Body of Christ, we are instructed to teach, exhort, encourage, and admonish one another in the ways of the Lord, helping each believer grow into spiritual maturity and fulfill their divine purpose. Scripture References: Colossians 3:16; 1 Thessalonians 5:14; Colossians 1:28.

We believe in water baptism by total immersion, as taught in Scripture. This act signifies that the believer has died with Christ and has been raised with Him into a brand-new life—a life lived for God and no longer under the rule of the unregenerated self or sinful nature. Baptism is an outward testimony of an inward transformation and a public declaration of one’s union with Christ. Scripture References: Romans 6:4; Colossians 2:11–12.
5) The Authority Of The Holy Scriptures:

We believe the Bible in its entirety—the inspired, God-breathed Word of God and the infallible rule of faith and conduct. Scripture is eternal, unchanging, and fully sufficient for teaching, correction, instruction, and equipping believers for every good work. Scripture References: 2 Timothy 3:16–17; Psalm 119:89.

We believe that Jesus Christ, the only begotten Son of God, was conceived by the Holy Spirit, born of the Virgin Mary, and lived a sinless life as the perfect Lamb of God. He was crucified, died, and was buried; on the third day He rose again in power and glory. He ascended into Heaven and is now seated at the right hand of God the Father, reigning in majesty and authority. We affirm that Jesus Christ alone is the only true God, worthy of all worship, honor, and praise. Scripture References: Matthew 1:20–24; Matthew 2:1; Ephesians 1:20–23.
7) The Holy Spirit God And His Baptism:

We believe that every believer receives the indwelling Holy Spirit at the moment of salvation. We further believe that believers should earnestly desire and seek the baptism (fullness) of the Holy Spirit, which empowers the Christian life and is accompanied by the manifestations of the gifts and the fruits of the Holy Spirit. Through His presence, power, and workings, the Holy Spirit equips the Church to fulfill the will of God on the earth. Scripture References: Matthew 3:11; Acts 10:47–48; Acts 4:31; Acts 2:1–47; 1 Corinthians 12:1–11; Galatians 5:22.
8) A Life Of Faith And Obedience:

We believe that a Christian is in right standing with God through faith in Jesus Christ, and that this faith produces visible, Spirit-empowered fruit in every area of life—personal, family, and church. Genuine faith is evidenced by the actions and character that flow from the indwelling Holy Spirit. Those who truly love the Lord will keep and obey His Word, and doing so is not burdensome but a joyful expression of their love for Him. Scripture References: Matthew 7:16–20; Romans 3:22; Galatians 2:16.
9) The Ministry And Work Of The Holy Spirit God:

We believe that the ministry of the Holy Spirit is to glorify the Lord Jesus Christ, to convict the world of sin, to regenerate those who believe, and to indwell, baptize, guide, and empower every believer for godly living and faithful service. Scripture References: John 16:8–14; Titus 3:5; 1 Corinthians 12:13; Romans 8:9–14; Acts 1:8.
10) The Threefold Witness In The Life Of A Believer:

We believe that every believer must personally be aligned with the Blood of Jesus, the Word of Jesus, and the Spirit of Jesus—for these three bear witness and affirm the believer’s standing in Christ before the Father on the great day of judgment. Scripture References: 1 John 5:8, Ephesians 1:7, Hebrews 9:14. Revelation 12:1, John 17:17, Hebrews 4:12, James 1:21. Romans 8:16, John 14:26, Ephesians 1:13-14.

We believe in tithing and bringing offerings into the local assembly (Church or ministry) where believers are nourished with the true, anointed Word of God—Heavenly Manna—through diligent guidance and spiritual care provided by the anointed shepherd of that assembly. We also believe in giving alms and showing Christlike compassion by caring for the poor, the sick, the homeless, and all who are in need. Scripture References: Malachi 3:10–11; Luke 6:38; James 1:27.
12) The Unity And Equality Of All Believers In Jesus Christ:

We believe that all humanity is one race before God and before one another. In Christ, there is no discrimination based on age, sex, or color—for Christ Himself is our focus, and He dwells in all believers and can use anyone who is willing and obedient. Scripture References: Colossians 3:11. Galatians 3:28, Romans 2:11, Acts 17:26, Genesis 1:27, 1 Samuel 16:7, Acts 2:17-18, Acts 10:34-35.
13) The Resurrection Of The Saved And Unsaved:

We believe in the bodily resurrection of the saved to everlasting life in the presence of God. We also believe in the resurrection of the unsaved to judgment and everlasting separation from God in the lake of Fire and Sulphur. Scripture References: John 5:28-29, Matthew 25:31-46; Acts 24:15 ; Revelation 22:1, Daniel 12:2
14) The Personal And Imminent Return of Jesus Christ:

We believe in the personal and imminent return of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ. Scripture References: Acts 1:11, 1 Thessalonians 4:13-18, Acts 1:11, Revelation 1:7, Matthew 24:42-44, Titus 2:13, 2 Thessalonians 1:7-10, Matthew 25:31,

The Exodus Reveals Christ: From Bondage to Eternal Inheritance:
When we read the Scriptures in the counsel and interpretation of the Holy Spirit God, this is what we understand: the Old Testament reveals Christ Jesus and His holy ways for us to follow today.
Egypt = The land of sin, bondage, slavery to sin, its consequences, and its curses.
Pharaoh of Egypt = Satan and the rulers of darkness in high places in this world, who hold people captive and resist the deliverance of God.
Israel in bondage = The people of God, including us before redemption, trapped under oppression, sin, fear, labor, and spiritual captivity.
The cry of Israel = The cry of the afflicted heart that reaches heaven when the people are weary under sin, oppression, and bondage.
God hearing their cry = The mercy of God responding to the suffering of His people and remembering His covenant.
Moses = A shadow and type of Jesus Christ, our Deliverer, Savior, and Messiah.
The burning bush = The holy calling and revelation of God, where God reveals Himself and sends His servant with divine authority.
Moses confronting Pharaoh = Jesus Christ confronting the kingdom of darkness and commanding freedom for those who belong to God.
The plagues of Egypt = The judgments of God against the false gods, pride, systems, and powers that exalt themselves against Him.
The Passover lamb = Jesus Christ, the Lamb of God, whose blood delivers us from judgment and death.
The blood on the doorposts = The blood of Jesus Christ covering, protecting, redeeming, and marking the people of God as His own.
The Red Sea = The separation between the old life and the new life; the death of the old bondage and the beginning of the walk of faith.
Crossing the Red Sea = Baptism and deliverance, where the people of God leave Egypt behind and pass into a new journey with God.
Pharaoh’s army drowned = The defeat of Satan’s pursuing powers and the destruction of the old bondage that tried to reclaim God’s people.

The wilderness = The place of testing, purification, dependence, humility, and learning to walk by faith and not by sight, where God separates our attachment from this world, its lusts, and its desires.
Manna from heaven = Jesus Christ, the true Bread from heaven, and the daily Word of God that sustains the believer.
Water from the rock = The living waters of the Holy Spirit God flowing from Christ Jesus to refresh and sustain His people.
The cloud by day and fire by night = The guidance, covering, protection, and presence of God leading His people.

Testing and backsliding in the wilderness = The place where many turned back in their hearts to Egypt, which represents sin. Instead of being satisfied with the heavenly Bread of Life, Jesus Christ, they began craving the lusts, desires, comforts, money, attention, and pleasures of this world.
Mount Horeb / Mount Sinai = The place of encounter, covenant, holiness, and the presence of God the Father.
Moses leading them to Mount Horeb = Jesus Christ leading us into the presence of God the Father.

Moses giving the law at Mount Horeb = A shadow of Jesus Christ giving us His words. As we daily read, meditate, obey, and apply His words to our lives, His divine instruction is fulfilled and written upon our hearts by the Spirit of God.
The tabernacle = Christ dwelling among His people and the pattern of worship, holiness, sacrifice, and access to God.
The priesthood = A shadow of Jesus Christ, our great High Priest, who brings us before the Father.
The sacrifices = The foreshadowing of the one perfect sacrifice of Jesus Christ on the cross.
The promised land = The life of covenant fullness, fruitfulness, inheritance, obedience, and eternal rest with God in heaven.
Canaan’s giants = The strongholds, fears, enemies, temptations, and spiritual battles that must be overcome by faith and obedience in order to possess the inheritance God has promised.

Wherever you are in your journey with Jesus Christ, remember that this is a race. There will be many hurdles, battles, tests, and warfare to overcome before we possess our eternal inheritance in heaven. Many began the journey out of Egypt, but gave up midway between Horeb and the promised land. They traded their eternal inheritance for earthly desires.

Therefore, do not turn back to Egypt in your heart. Do not become satisfied with the temporary comforts of this world. Do not exchange the Bread of Life for the cravings of the flesh. Keep your eyes on Jesus Christ, follow His words, endure the wilderness with faith, overcome the giants through obedience, and finish the race set before you.

For Christ Jesus did not deliver us from Egypt so we could die in unbelief in the wilderness. He delivered us so we could belong to God, walk in holiness, be transformed by His Word and Spirit, and enter into the eternal inheritance prepared for those who love Him and obey Him.
